prompt: Here's a small single-node search-index service. It keeps an in-memory inverted index and reloads it correctly on boot, and every read path (search, autocomplete) works fine — so functionally there's nothing wrong with it. But look at how it persists writes: after indexing a single document, it re-serializes the entire index (every term, every posting list, every document record) into one JSON blob and writes that to disk. Walk me through what that costs as the corpus grows, and how you'd fix it. What would you change about the persistence strategy, and what do you give up by doing so?
